'''Wachs Tauph''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Bothan/Legends|Bothan]] [[Professor/Legends|professor]] who worked as a university chancellor. In [[17 BBY/Legends|17 BBY]], he attended the launch of the luxury [[Hovertrain/Legends|repulsortrain]] ''[[Gem of Alderaan]]'', on [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]].
